pages.text: $(thing)Create: Interiors$() is furniture built for Create. Its chairs and seats $(bold)anchor you onto a contraption$(), so you can sit in a moving vehicle and ride along. Cushions are bouncy.

pages.title: Chair
pages.text: Right-click to sit. Sneak to get up. Use a Wrench to toggle armrests and, while sneaking, the back size. Comes in many dye colours.

pages.title: Floor Chair and Cushion
pages.text: Low floor seating and soft cushions in every colour. There is also a Wall Mounted Table and a Kelp Seat.

For vehicles see $(l:create_basics/contraptions)Contraptions$(/l), $(l:transport/trains)Trains$(/l) and $(l:flight/airships)Airships$(/l).$(br2)Other furniture: $(l:home/building)Furniture and Decor$(/l).
